text.p: Following are the main stories in Slovenia's Thursday morning newspapers.
- Parliament started debating a new bill that would ensure financing of necessary cultural programmes.

- Parliament has not yet decided whether to grant compensation to relatives of people who died in the 10-day war with the Yugoslavian army that followed Slovenia's declaration of independence in 1991.
- The government is expected to present the 1997 budget proposal on Thursday.
- In the first six months of this year the number of tourist overnight stays in Slovenia increased by 10n percent compared to the same period of 1996.
- The blue-chip SBI stock index climed over 1,500 points on Wednesday, increasing by about 20 percent since the Bank of Slovenia eased foreign investment rules a month ago.
- Private firm SI.MOBIL said it would apply for a mobile phone operator's license in Slovenia.
